_comment: Fixture cases for rule-admit.test.sh. Each case overrides `base`: `issue` merges into base.issue, `comments` and `last_edited_at` replace the base values when present. Expected verdicts come from the owner-approved rules (autonomy admission-policy leaf, 'Rule admission') and the draft's test results, named per case in `source`.
